name: nibbi
description: Nibbi — Oracle's new face: a little ink-blot character at the center of the app. Zero-build web surface + zero-dep host that proxies to the Oracle gateway.

scripts.deploy: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$HOME/Oracle/desktop/src-tauri/target npm --prefix desktop run build && rm -rf "$HOME/Applications/Nibbi.app" && cp -R "$HOME/Oracle/desktop/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Nibbi.app" "$HOME/Applications/Nibbi.app" && echo "Nibbi.app installed"
